parsed.name: HP 8901B 调制分析仪
parsed.description: HP 8901B 是一台射频调制分析仪，频率范围约为 150 kHz 至 1.3 GHz。它用于测试通信与射频信号的调制特性，适合在实验室中对信号源、发射机及相关电子设备进行 AM、FM 调制测量与性能评估。
parsed.description_en: The HP 8901B is an RF modulation analyzer covering approximately 150 kHz to 1.3 GHz. It is used in laboratories to evaluate the modulation characteristics of communication and RF signals, including AM and FM measurements on signal sources, transmitters, and related electronic equipment.

actions.description: 测量输入射频信号的调频（FM）调制量。
actions.description_en: Measure the frequency modulation (FM) of the input RF signal.

actions.description: 测量输入射频信号的调幅（AM）调制量。
actions.description_en: Measure the amplitude modulation (AM) of the input RF signal.
